title: Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.23877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. translated_title: 大规模可解释推荐：基于LLM理由生成的YouTube音乐艺人发现
translated_abstract: 现代音乐流媒体平台面临一个持续的权衡：是利用用户熟悉的内容，还是推动用户探索新内容。虽然用户经常渴望发现新音乐，但他们在选择未知艺人时往往犹豫不决，不愿放弃已被证明喜爱的艺人。提供透明的自然语言理由来解释为什么推荐某个未探索的内容可以降低这一障碍。然而，尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在这种细致的可解释性方面表现出色，但其实时部署受到高昂的推理成本和计算开销的严重限制。在本文中，我们展示了一个工业案例研究，介绍了一种解耦的推荐架构，该架构在不影响延迟的情况下成功扩展了探索功能。我们的系统将LLM推理异步地隔离在离线环境中，预先计算包含未发现艺人的个性化候选池以及定制的推荐理由。大规模在线A/B实验验证了我们的设计。我们证明……
tldr: 该论文提出一种解耦推荐架构，通过离线异步预计算LLM生成的个性化推荐理由，在不影响延迟的前提下实现了YouTube音乐平台大规模的可解释新艺人探索推荐。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a decoupled recommendation architecture that scales explainable music artist discovery on YouTube by asynchronously pre-computing LLM-generated personalized rationales offline, enabling novel artist exploration without compromising latency.
